evidence_items.locator: Opening paragraph; Negative Sentiment About AI Has Increased; Survey Methods

receipt.public_excerpt: Anger about the technology has risen

evidence_items.explanation: The survey ending March 4 found Gen Z anger rising from 22% to 31% over a year, while excitement fell 14 percentage points. These are substantial changes, although weekly use remained essentially stable.

The national adult survey found expected harm to daily life rising from 44% in April 2025 to 55%, corroborating worsening sentiment beyond Gen Z. However, its trust measure was largely unchanged, so deterioration was not uniform across measures.

evidence_items.locator: Paragraph following the canceled-project investment totals
evidence_items.explanation: Heatmap counted at least 20 cancellations following local opposition in the first quarter, compared with roughly 25 during all of 2025. This corroborates growing infrastructure opposition, but the article explicitly includes facilities not intended to run AI models.

unresolved_gaps: The evidence does not establish a worldwide trend or a precise rate of growth during May itself.
Negative sentiment and continued adoption coexist; backlash does not imply that people stopped using AI.
